title: Real sparse Fourier polynomial value
statement: For a natural number $n$, a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $n$ Boolean coordinates, and an input $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, its real value is the sum over its support of each rational coefficient, viewed as a real number, times the corresponding Fourier monomial at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: a sparse Fourier hypothesis on $n$ Boolean coordinates
